    """Return (name_text, added_text, due_datetime_or_text) split around Added and Due."""

    s = str(s)
    m_added = re.search(r'\bADDED\b', s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m_added:
        return None, None, None
    name = s[:m_added.start()]  # preserve the separator before "Added" (matches the worked example)
    rest = s[m_added.end():]

    if not m_due:
        added = rest.lstrip()
        due_text = ''
    else:
        added = rest[:m_due.start()].lstrip()  # worked example removes the space just after Added
        due_text = rest[m_due.end():].strip()
    
    # Dates are due dates in 2021; parse to a real Excel date/datetime, as in the example cell E4.

        cleaned = cleaned + ' 2021'
    for fmt in ('%d %b %Y', '%d %B %Y', '%m/%d/%Y', '%d/%m/%Y', '%Y-%m-%d'):
